tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// bsun zlog gi cho ga mdor bsdus pa grub pa'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī bhyaḥ bsun zlog khyer bde'i bca' gzhi ni/ gung du rang nyid kyis sgrol dkar sogs yi dam gang byed kyi mchod gtor dang*/ nye logs su gtong zlum lnga tshom pad 'dab can mtheb kyu dang ril bus brgyan pa/ las bzhi'i dpal gtor zlum po/ gru bzhi/ zla gam/ zur gsum rnams theb kyu dang ril bus brgyan cing spro na kha dog so sor bsgyur/ rin po che'i snod du gser skyems bcas bsham/ de rnams kyi mdun du sku glud che ba glud phran mang pos bskor ba dang*/ nyer spyod dang*/ 'dod yon sogs spyan gzigs dkor cha ci 'byor pas mdzes par bya/ de nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod gtor dang*/ sku glud rnams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ kha dog lnga ldan las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba bcud zag pa med pa'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ mthing ga rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor 'od du zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi mchod sprin zad mi shes pa nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ ces brlabs te spyir bsngo ba ni/ hrīḥ chos

lha btsun rin po che nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi dag snang ma/ dbyings lhun grub 'od zer phyogs mtshams 'khrigs// rang gsal pad sdong 'od kyi pho brang dbus// tshe lha yab yid bzhin 'khor lo sogs kha bsgyur/ yum snang stong 'od zer klong*// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor// bka' nyan dregs pa las byed chos srung rnams// 'dir gshegs mchod gtor sku glud tshogs mchod dang*// nam mkha' gang ba'i phyi nang gsang mchod sprin// dgyes par bzhes la phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs// oṃ badzra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā zhes mchod/ de nas rigs lnga'i lha tshogs la mchod gtor 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhe sdang rnam dag rdo rje rigs kyi lha/ chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i mnal lam ma/ /zhi ba'i las mdzad 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// shar phyogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma zlog /'byung ba chu dang nyon mongs zhe sdang las// gyur pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad kun sol la// me long ye shes rdo rje tshe dbang bskur// mi 'gyur mi shigs rab tu brtan par mdzod// nga rgyal rnam dag rin chen rigs kyi lha// rgyas pa'i las mdzad 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// lho phyogs rin chen mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma zlog /'byung ba sa dang nyon mongs nga rgyal las// gyur pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad kun sol la// mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen tshe dbang bskur// mi 'gyur mi shigs rab tu brtan par mdzod// 'dod chags rnam dag padma rigs kyi lha// dbang gi las mdzad 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// nub phyogs padma mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma zlog /'byung ba me dang nyon mongs 'dod chags las// gyur pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad kun sol la// sor rtog ye shes padma tshe dbang bskur// mi 'gyur mi shigs rab tu brtan par mdzod// phrag dog rnam dag las kyi rigs kyi lha// mngon spyod las mdzad 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// byang phyogs las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma zlog

/'byung ba rlung dang nyon mongs phrag dog las// gyur pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad kun sol la// bya grub ye shes phrin las tshe dbang bskur// mi 'gyur mi shigs rab tu brtan par mdzod// gti mug rnam dag sangs rgyas rigs kyi lha// lhun grub las mdzad 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// dbus phyogs buddha mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma zlog /'byung ba mkha' dang nyon mongs gti mug las// gyur pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad kun sol la// chos dbyings ye shes lhun grub tshe dbang bskur// mi 'gyur mi shigs rab tu brtan par mdzod// las bzhi'i gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ shar lha btsun rin po che'i gsung*/ nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar mo 'bum// zhe sdang las la rngams pa'i lha srin tshogs// zhi ba'i mchod gtor bzhes la bar chad sol// me long ye shes ngang du dar thag sdus// lho nas rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo 'bum// nga rgyal las la rngams pa'i lha srin tshogs// rgyas pa'i mchod gtor bzhes la bar chad sol// mnyam nyid ye shes ngang du dar thag sdus// nub nas padma mkha' 'gro dmar mo 'bum// 'dod chags las la rngams pa'i lha srin tshogs// dbang gi mchod gtor bzhes la bar chad sol// sor rtog ye shes ngang du dar thag sdus// byang nas las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang nag 'bum// phrag dog las la rngams pa'i lha srin tshogs// drag po'i mchod gtor bzhes la bar chad sol// bya grub ye shes ngang du dar thag sdus// mtshams bzhi'i dpa' bo ḍā ki chos skyong yang*// rang rang bran g.yog lha srin sde brgyad bcas// las bzhi'i mchod gtor bzhes la bar chad sol// rang rang dar thag chos kyi dbyings su sdus// snang srid thams cad sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i zhing*// sku gsum 'bras bu ye nas lhun grub dang*// chos kyi dbyings na bzang ngan 'pho 'gyur bral// mnyam nyid ngang du rnam rtog 'chi ba zlog

/grangs gsog byed na/ mchod gtor so sor gso bran byas la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis brlab/ rigs lnga dang las bzhi'i mchod gtor 'bul ba la grangs bzung*/ grangs rdzogs pa na rigs lnga'i gtor ma khang thog gi dbus dang*/ las bzhi phyogs bzhir dbul/ de nas gser skyems/ chos kyi dbyings dang nam mkha'i khyon gang ba'i// las bzhir dbang bsgyur dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// sde brgyad dregs pa'i bsun ma bzlog tu gsol// sngon las 'phral rkyen ltas ngan bar chad dang*// chags chen nyam nga rbod gtong byad stems rnams// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i bden pas zlog /tshe rku srog 'phrog stobs dpal dbang thang dang*// bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'gal ba'i bsun ma zlog /bla tshe srog tshe dbugs tshe yar dang gud// nyams chad dus min 'chi ba'i ltas mi bzang*// chos skyong srung ma'i dpung gis bzlog par gyis// dpa' bo ḍā ki'i nus pas mtshams chod cig /bla ma yi dam thugs rjes deng skyobs la// stan 'dir 'chi med rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol// slar yang sku glud/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ātya nutpanna twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā zhes brlabs la/ e waṃ mnyam sbyor thabs shes dbyings chen po// e yam̐ ram̐ sum̐ kam̐ ram̐ bhrūm̐ 'od dang*// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥdang ā li dang*// kā li thabs shes mnyam sbyor rten 'brel bcud// ting 'dzin 'od skur 'dus pa'i dgyes mchod sprin// zab gsang rdo rje dbyings kyi rol rgyan du// rnam rol ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi glud// 'pho ba chen po rtag brtan 'gyur med dang*// 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i zhing du 'bul// bzhes nas dngos 'dzin mtshan ma'i rnam rtog sol// skye 'chi'i 'dzin mdangs 'ja' skur yal gyur cig /glud grangs gsog na glud phran re re nas byin rlabs dang 'bul ba gong ltar byas pa'i mthar/ sku gsum phyogs dus rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi// dbyings mchog 'od gsal dwangs ma rdo rje'i yum// rigs 'dus 'bum phrag ye shes ḍā ki ma// lhan skyes srid zhir ro gcig rdo rje'i dbyings// 'bar ba'i 'od skur brjid pa'i gtor ma dang*// srid zhi'i bde chen phun tshogs mchod pa'i sprin// lhun 'byams shar grol dag pa'i klong nas bzhes// mtshan 'dzin bar chad thams cad chos skur zlog

/mi shigs gsang mchog rdo rje'i mkha' dbyings su// 'khor 'das rnam rol sgyu ma'i rol rtsed bsdu// kun tu bzang mo'i dbyings kyi 'od gsal dang*// snying gur dbus su 'chi med bdud rtsir āḥ /zhes gtor ma sku glud rnams rol mo'i sgra dang bcas nub phyogs su bskyal/ drag sngags kyis mtshams gcad/ rdo rje'i srung 'khor bsgom/ bsngo smon bkra shis rgyas par bya'o// bla ma sogs kyi ched du yin na/ srung 'khor bsgoms pa'i rjes so so'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs grangs mang du 'don pa'am/ brtan bzhugs spyi 'gre/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī banti ye swā hā/ bla ma mchog gsum yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i bden stobs kyis// bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon rje btsun bla ma mchog /bskal brgyar zhabs brtan phrin las rgyas gyur cig /ces dang*// snang chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i gsung*/ stong bde chen gzhom med rdo rje'i sku// mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rab rgyas rgyal kun gyi// ngo mtshar spyi gzugs gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku// 'gyur med sku yi rdo rje zhabs brtan gsol// grag stong 'gag pa med pa rdo rje'i gsung*// yan lag drug cu zab gsang chos kyi sgra// 'gro blo'i bsam pa bzhin ston longs spyod rdzogs// 'gag med gsung gi rdo rje zhabs brtan gsol// rig stong skye 'gag gnas bral rdo rje'i thugs// zab gsal ye shes chos kun 'byung ba'i dbyings// khyab bdag rgyal ba'i snying po chos kyi sku// 'khrul med thugs kyi rdo rje zhabs brtan gsol// kun khyab mkha' la phrin las nyin mor byed// 'char nub yongs bral phan bde'i snang ba can// bstan 'gro'i pad tshal rgyas pa'i nyer 'tsho mchog /bskal pa rgya mtshor rab tu gsal gyur cig /phan bde 'byung ba'i sogs dang*/ ston pa 'jig rten khams su sogs brjod cing gsol ba rtse gcig tu gdab bo// yang rang nyid la bka' drin che ba'i rdo rje'i slob dpon sogs yul khyad par can la brtan bzhugs dmigs bsal 'bul ba'i tshul ni sgrol dkar gyi sgo nas logs su bkod pa ltar shes par bya'o//

༈ /yang bsun zlog gi bcas 'don shin tu bsdu na/ shoms kyi skabs mkha' 'gro'i dpal gtor/ gser skyems/ sku glud tsam gyis 'thus/ dngos gzhir khrus gsol gyi rjes glud gtor bsang sbyang*// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dag pa rab 'byams kyi mdangs nam mkha'i snod chen por 'dod yon zad pa med pa'i longs spyod kyi gter du gyur par bsams la nam mkha' mdzod kyi rig pa brjod/ kye/ dpal 'khor 'das kun tu 'char ba'i chos rgyal gter bdag gling ba'i gsung*/ ma// don dug lnga dag pa'i ye shes lnga// rigs lnga yi sgyu 'phrul 'gag med du// tshul cir yang snang ba'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// 'khor grangs med kyi pho nyar bcas pa rnams// sku mdzes pa'i rgyan 'chang brda tshig gsung*// thugs bde chen gyis rab myos sprin phung bzhin// deng 'dir gshegs bdag gi tshig 'dir dgongs// mgon rdo rje slob dpon sku gzugs tshab// dpal kun tu bzang po'i longs spyod sprin// dbyings srid zhi gang ba'i nam mkha'i mdzod// de zag med bdud rtsir sbyar te 'bul// thugs dgyes pa chen pos bzhes nas kyang*// spyir dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe srings// sgos rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma zlog /brda tha snyad kyi dar thag dbyings su chod// mgon rigs brgya'i khyab bdag bla ma rje// dus ji srid du mi g.yo zhabs brtan cing*// chos zab don gyis grangs med gdul bya'i 'gro// rgyud smin grol du mdzad la gegs med mdzod// ces gtor ma dang sku glud rnams rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas nub phyogs su phul la/ drag sngags brjod cing slar mi 'tshe ba'i bden stobs brjod pa dwang du blangs par mos te rdo rje'i srung 'khor bsgom/ zhabs brtan gyi cho ga 'bul na skabs 'dir rgyas bsdus gang byed dang 'brel bar zhabs brtan gsol 'debs grangs mang gi mthar brtan bzhugs spyi khyab gong ltar ram dmigs bsal gang dgos sbyar te bsngo smon bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// de ltar cho ga gang la'ang kha bsgyur chog pa'i tshul 'di nyid 'brel chags par btang grub pa na cho ga'i rjes bsdu ba ni gzhung bzhin no// zhes pa'ang rje bla ma'i chog khrigs nyid kha bsgyur gyi rnam pa gsal ba blo gter dbang pos bris pa dge legs 'phel//

// ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
